scripts.build: tsc -b packages/react-slot/tsconfig.build.json packages/react-hover-highlight/tsconfig.build.json packages/react-grid-list/tsconfig.build.json && cp packages/react-hover-highlight/src/styles.css packages/react-hover-highlight/dist/ && cp packages/react-grid-list/src/styles.css packages/react-grid-list/dist/
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/react-slot && tsc -p packages/react-hover-highlight && tsc -p packages/react-grid-list && tsc -p scripts
scripts.check: bun run clean && bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun scripts/check-dist.ts
